# HIP Documentation

> HIP is a C++ runtime API and kernel language that lets developers create portable applications for AMD and NVIDIA GPUs from a single source. This documentation covers the HIP programming model, runtime API, porting from CUDA, API reference, and tutorials. For the broader ROCm software stack, see https://rocm.docs.amd.com.

## Getting started

- [What is HIP?](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/what_is_hip.html): Overview of HIP and its place in the ROCm ecosystem.
- [HIP 7 changes](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/hip-7-changes.html): Summary of changes introduced in HIP 7.
- [FAQ](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/faq.html): Frequently asked questions about HIP.
- [Installing HIP](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/install/install.html): Install HIP on a supported system.
- [Building HIP from source](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/install/build.html): Build HIP from source.

## Programming guide

### Understand HIP

- [Programming model](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/understand/programming_model.html): The HIP programming model and execution concepts.
- [Hardware implementation](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/understand/hardware_implementation.html): How HIP maps to GPU hardware.
- [Compilers](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/understand/compilers.html): HIP compiler overview.
- [AMD common language runtime (CLR)](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/understand/amd_clr.html): The AMD common language runtime.

### How to

- [HIP runtime API](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/hip_runtime_api.html): Using the HIP runtime API, including initialization, memory management, error handling, streams, graphs, cooperative groups, multi-device, and interop.
- [C++ language extensions](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/hip_cpp_language_extensions.html): HIP C++ language extensions and the kernel language.
- [HIP porting guide](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/hip_porting_guide.html): Port CUDA code to HIP.
- [HIP RTC](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/hip_rtc.html): Runtime compilation with HIP RTC.
- [Performance guidelines](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/performance_guidelines.html): Practical guidelines for optimizing HIP application performance.
- [Debugging](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/how-to/debugging.html): Debugging HIP applications.

## Reference

- [HIP runtime API reference](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/hip_runtime_api_reference.html): Complete HIP runtime API reference, organized by module.
- [Math API](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/math_api.html): HIP math and complex math API.
- [Environment variables](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/env_variables.html): HIP environment variables.
- [Error codes](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/error_codes.html): HIP error codes.
- [Deprecated APIs](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/deprecated_api_list.html): List of deprecated HIP APIs.
- [Hardware features](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/reference/hardware_features.html): GPU hardware features.

## Tutorials

- [SAXPY tutorial](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/tutorial/saxpy.html): A first HIP program.
- [Programming patterns](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/tutorial/programming-patterns.html): Common GPU programming patterns, including matrix multiplication, histograms, k-means, stencils, and BFS.
- [Reduction](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/tutorial/reduction.html): Implementing reductions in HIP.
- [Cooperative groups](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/tutorial/cooperative_groups_tutorial.html): Using cooperative groups.
- [Graph API](https://rocm.docs.amd.com/projects/HIP/en/latest/tutorial/graph_api.html): Using the HIP graph API.
- [HIP examples (GitHub)](https://github.com/ROCm/rocm-examples): HIP example programs, including HIP-Basic.
